name: Terminal Plugin
description: xterm.js terminal emulator plugin. Creates a Terminal instance with Noir custom theme (#161C24 background, #C8D6E5 foreground, #00E5FF cursor). Connects to node-pty backend via IPC channels. Custom keyboard handler: Ctrl+Shift+C copies selection, Ctrl+Shift+V pastes clipboard to PTY (no local echo). Uses FitAddon and ResizeObserver for container-fit adaptation. Canvas zoom handled by PluginCard CSS transform — no PTY resize on zoom. On exit callback fires when terminal process terminates.

interface.constructor: (container: HTMLElement, uuid: string, cwd?: string) — Creates root div element (100% width/height, overflow hidden), initializes xterm.js Terminal with Noir theme and custom key handler, attaches FitAddon, connects to PTY via IPC terminal:create, sets up ResizeObserver for container-fit adaptation, registers terminal:data and terminal:exit listeners

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Calls FitAddon.fit() to recalculate terminal columns/rows for current container dimensions

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: No-op — PluginCard handles canvas zoom via CSS transform, no PTY resize or font size change needed at the terminal level

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Idempotent cleanup: kills PTY via IPC terminal:kill, unsubscribes terminal:data and terminal:exit listeners, disconnects ResizeObserver, disposes FitAddon and xterm Terminal, removes root element from DOM. Sets destroyed flag to prevent re-destruction

properties.name: uuid
properties.description: Unique terminal identifier used to route IPC messages (terminal:write, terminal:resize, terminal:kill) and filter inbound events (terminal:data, terminal:exit) to the correct terminal instance

properties.name: element
properties.description: Root container div (width:100%, height:100%, overflow:hidden) that hosts the xterm.js viewport via Terminal.open()

properties.name: onExit
properties.description: Callback fired when the terminal PTY process exits, triggered by terminal:exit IPC event. Set by CanvasArea to handle card cleanup

events.name: onExit
events.description: Fired when the PTY process on the main process terminates; null if no callback is set. Used by CanvasArea to handle terminal card cleanup

features.copy_selection: Ctrl+Shift+C copies selected text from terminal to system clipboard via IPC clipboard:writeText
features.paste_clipboard: Ctrl+Shift+V reads clipboard via IPC clipboard:readText and writes to PTY via IPC terminal:write (no local echo — PTY echo provides visual feedback)
features.container_fit: FitAddon + ResizeObserver adapt terminal cols/rows to container dimensions on card resize; canvas zoom via CSS transform does NOT trigger PTY resize

lifecycle.created_by: CanvasArea.addTerminal() — instantiated when user creates a new terminal card via button or keyboard shortcut
lifecycle.destroyed_by: CanvasArea.terminateCard() → TerminalPlugin.destroy() — kills PTY, disconnects all listeners and ResizeObserver, disposes xterm/FitAddon, removes element from DOM
